rules.audience: Recent CSE graduate with CS foundations, no industry experience required
rules.question_count: Dynamic with no fixed minimum or maximum; more than 15 for rich sections if justified, fewer than 15 for brief sections. No filler.
rules.sequence: One continuous sequence; build questions naturally from initial concepts and actual examples toward applied reasoning, only as supported in the current transcript section; no difficulty buckets.
rules.answer_format: Place an accurate, transcript-supported answer immediately after every question.
rules.scope: Only the concepts, examples, procedures, commands and demonstrations of this exact transcript section; no material from later sections, no outside knowledge.
duplicate_checks: Read existing index and section files before writing
Check exact wording and semantic equivalents across all sections
Retain question IDs when modifying unchanged concepts
rules.coverage_rationale: Always include an explicit section-level coverage rationale tied to transcript subtopics and question IDs. If <15 questions, explain why that number covers all distinct important concepts without padding. If >15, explain why extra questions are necessary. At exactly 15, a coverage audit is still useful.
